name: Game leaderboard
description: Query defaults are computed in a map task, not inline in params: db_read folds {"var": ..} nodes only, so an 'or' written directly in params reaches Postgres as a literal object. See orion-gaps.md N1. The defaults are the strings "50" and "0" because that is what the query string delivers; the placeholder's declared type converts, so the spelling no longer matters (orion-gaps.md N6). Postgres builds the response: the one `body` column is json_build_object over the page, and since Orion 1.6 a json column decodes as the document itself, so the respond task copies it into data.body. Pagination is OFFSET on purpose, the cursor being the offset as a string: the sort key is a live rating that every match rewrites, so a keyset position would drift exactly as an offset does, and `rank` is a position in the whole ladder either way. See orion-gaps.md G5.

input.query: WITH page AS ( SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY r.conservative DESC, m.id) AS rank,        m.id::text AS model_id, u.handle AS owner, m.version,        m.weight_class::text AS class, m.size_bytes,        r.conservative AS rating, (r.matches_played < 20) AS provisional,        r.matches_played AS matches FROM models m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.owner_id JOIN games g ON g.id = m.game_id JOIN ratings r ON r.model_id = m.id AND r.ladder = ($2)::ladder WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND m.status = 'active'   AND (($2)::text = 'open' OR m.weight_class = ($2)::ladder) ORDER BY r.conservative DESC, m.id OFFSET ($4)::int LIMIT ($3)::int) SELECT json_build_object(   'entries', coalesce(json_agg(page ORDER BY page.rank), '[]'::json),   'next_cursor', CASE WHEN count(*) = ($3)::int                       THEN (($4)::int + ($3)::int)::text ELSE NULL END) AS body FROM page
